user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.

positive.title: Mark a task as complete
steps: Select a task that is currently incomplete.
positive.expected_result: The selected task is marked as complete and visually indicated as such.

negative.title: Attempt to mark a non-existent task as complete
steps: Attempt to access a task that is not in the list.
Try to click the 'Mark as Complete' button for this nonexistent task.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the task does not exist, and marking action is not allowed.

edge.title: Marking the last visible task as complete
steps: Navigate to the task list with a single task.
Select the last remaining incomplete task.
edge.expected_result: The task is marked as complete; the task list shows a message indicating no more incomplete tasks or an empty state visualization.
